Definition: Ram, the name of an Arabian and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Ram is the name of an Arabian and of an Israelite. Ram the son of Hezron was the father of Amminadab, in the line of Judah that runs to David; Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse — and Ram stands in the genealogy Ruth closes with; and Elihu was of the kindred of Ram, the Buzite.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Ram's name is a hinge: he stands in the genealogy that leads to David, and his kinsman Elihu stands in the book of Job — one name, two lines, both counted.
